dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* Time has passed too quickly. The children have all grown up.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: ...But it turns out grown-up kids are no use! When Naphis comes after me, Cyno still can't do anything to protect me!

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: This atmosphere calls for a joke out of left field, to catch the listener unawares.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: (...I can't treat my students like kids anymore. I have to admit, Cyno has matured far beyond my expectations.)

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: (From now on, I'll just enjoy life as a retired sage. The future is safe in the hands of the younger generation.)

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: (Hmm... joke... how do I make this a joke...)
